subject: There’s a story only you can write
preheader: A small-group writing studio, a first-sentence exercise and room to begin.

content.text: Folio

Your next chapter
starts on the page.
Dear writer,
You don’t need a finished idea to begin. A conversation overheard. A room you remember. One detail that refuses to leave. That’s enough.
Our small-group writing studio gives those beginnings a place to grow: six weeks of practical exercises, thoughtful feedback and time set aside for your own work.
Come as you are. Bring a notebook.
Mara Ellis · Course host
Try a first sentence.

“At the back of the cupboard,
she found the letter.”
Set a timer for ten minutes. Keep writing without explaining who sent it. Let one ordinary object carry the story.
A small exercise from our opening session.
Six weeks. A little more courage.
A clear rhythm, useful tools and a room full of people making a start.
Begin
Weeks 1–3
Notice the details. Build a character. Find the voice that belongs to your story.
Build
Weeks 4–6
Give your scene momentum. Share a short draft. Leave with a plan for what comes next.
Tuesdays · 12 January–16 February 2027
18:30–20:00 UTC · Live online · 12 writers
£180 for the complete course. Includes six live sessions, weekly exercises and a written note on your final draft.
